chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar and others, from Yunus, from them (peace be upon him), who said:

It is not befitting for the affluent Muslim to marry a slave girl except if he cannot find a free woman. Thus, similarly, it is not befitting for him to marry a woman from the People of the Book except in a state of necessity when he cannot find a Muslim woman, neither a free one nor a slave girl.
ai.seo_question: When is it permissible for an affluent Muslim to marry a slave girl or a woman from the People of the Book?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the preference for free Muslim women in marriage, extending the principle of 'not befitting' (la yanbaghi) to include women of the People of the Book for affluent men unless necessity dictates otherwise. It reflects the Shia juristic view that while marriage to a chaste woman of the Book is legally valid, it is discouraged for those who can afford a Muslim spouse, mirroring the ruling for slave girls. This establishes a hierarchy of marital eligibility based on faith and social status within the context of Islamic family law.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar and someone else, 
(It has been narrated) from Yunus, from them (one of the Imams<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘It is not befitting for the affluent Muslim that he marries the slave girl except if he cannot find a free woman. Thus, similar to that, it is not befitting for him that he marries a woman from the People of the Book except during a state of necessity when he cannot find a Muslim woman, neither a free one nor a slave girl’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Isma’il ibn Marrar and others from Yunus from ‘A’immah who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

It is not proper for an affluent Muslim man to marry a slave-girl unless he cannot find a free woman. So also, it is not proper for him to marry a woman from the people of the book unless it is an emergency when he cannot find a free Muslim woman or a slave- girl.’”
